subject: BrightCart POC: concise savings snapshot + quick reference ask
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kate Byrne <kate@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: BrightCart POC: concise savings snapshot + quick reference ask

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. The team pulled together a very short, quantified snapshot of the operational impact we observed during the two-week pilot. Highlights below (pulled from the attached one-pager):

- Average inference latency improved from 185ms -> 48ms (73% reduction) for the checkout personalization model.
- End-to-end cost-per-1M tokens decreased by ~58% after moving to Redwood's batching + KV cache config.
- Peak throughput increased 2.8x under the same instance footprint, enabling BrightCart to consolidate two inference clusters into one.
- Tail-99 latency cut by 65ms (material for UX-sensitive flows).

We keep the metrics tight because marketing prefers one-line, verifiable claims. Attached: brightcart_poc_metrics_summary.pdf (one-pager with charts + measurement notes).

Would BrightCart be comfortable with a brief public quote and a 15-minute call to review a one-paragraph case snippet? Example asks: a) a 1–2 sentence endorsement we can use in a short case blurb, and b) permission to publish the metrics above with BrightCart attribution.

If helpful, I can share a draft blurb and a 2-line quote for you to tweak. Proposed quick times: Nov 23 9:00–9:30 PT or Nov 24 10:30–11:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me when you're free and we'll take it.

Thanks — excited to make this a small launch for you and for the BrightCart engineering team.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[attachment: brightcart_poc_metrics_summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Kate Byrne <kate@brightcart.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Cole <brian.cole@brightcart.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart POC: concise savings snapshot + quick reference ask

Hi Aditya —

Really appreciate the tight summary. The numbers look right based on our telemetry; the latency and cost delta match what we saw in our perf dashboard. Happy to help with a short quote.

Two small asks before public attribution:
1) Can we redact absolute user counts from the one-pager? We prefer percentages and relative improvements for external materials.
2) For the quote, can BrightCart (ops team) remain the signatory rather than an individual? We typically ask legal to sign off on the final blurb.

I'm available for a 15-minute sync on Nov 23 at 9:00 PT. I'll loop Brian from engineering for the metric confirmation. I've attached the internal approval slide we usually circulate (brightcart_internal_approval.pdf).

A quick two-line quote from me for draft purposes: “Redwood helped us cut inference latency and unit cost dramatically during the POC — a clear win for both reliability and economics.” Feel free to edit.

Talk tomorrow —
Kate
VP Product, BrightCart

I'll also prepare a version of the one-pager that omits raw user numbers per Kate's ask.

Monica
